title: Index Apply readback and NO_OP
description: Index Apply does not prove per-step and final readback or a compatible zero-write NO_OP.
rationale: Apply completion requires exact final state and repeated compatible execution must perform no writes.
remediation: Read back every index write, require exact final equality, and return NO_OP with zero writes when current and required sets already match.

residualGate.description: Repeated compatible Apply and final tenant index readback remain external.
